menu.event:
local eventScreen = component:E("EventScreen")
eventScreen.bg.TopLeft("xOffset"):SetFloat(-3*game.windowScaleY()) eventScreen.bg.TopLeft("yOffset"):SetFloat(-6*game.windowScaleY())
eventScreen.bg.TopRight("xOffset"):SetFloat(-6*game.windowScaleY()) eventScreen.bg.TopRight("yOffset"):SetFloat(3*game.windowScaleY())
eventScreen.bg.BottomRight("xOffset"):SetFloat(-29*game.windowScaleY()) eventScreen.bg.BottomRight("yOffset"):SetFloat(-14*game.windowScaleY())
eventScreen.TitleImage.Sprite("size"):SetFloat(0.45*game.windowScaleY())
if not game.isIslandOwned(game.IslandType_BONE) then eventScreen.Description2.Text("text"):SetString("EVENT_SCREEN_BEAT_HEREAFTER_UNOWNED_BOTTOM") end
eventScreen:hideCloseButton()
